one_line: First Marakkar admiral of the Zamorin’s fleets on the Malabar coast in the early 1500s.

appearance.age_look: Late 30s to early 40s, medium height, wiry but solid sailor’s build with broad shoulders.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp cheekbones, warm medium-brown Malabar complexion, straight prominent nose, neatly trimmed black beard and moustache, a faint healed cut on his left eyebrow; default expression calm, alert and resolute.
appearance.hair: Thick wavy black hair pulled back to shoulder length, tied at the nape with a narrow dark red cloth band; a simple dark indigo Muslim-style turban wrapped low and close to the head with a subtle twist above the forehead and no jewel.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style tunic that overlaps and ties on the right side, the sleeve cuffs edged with a narrow dark red border, over a deep indigo cotton waist sash tightly wrapped and knotted on his left hip; below, loose straight-falling light brown cotton churidar-style trousers gathered modestly at the ankles and plain dark brown leather sandals with a toe loop; over the tunic he has a sleeveless dark green cotton outer vest, hip-length with side slits, lightly quilted and reinforced at the shoulders for sea duty; a simple brown leather belt crosses the sash and supports a wooden scabbard; he wears a short string of small dark wooden prayer beads at his neck, a single modest silver ring on his right hand, and small plain silver studs in both ears.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Malabar fighting sword (similar to an early talwar) with a simple iron hilt wrapped in dark brown leather and a plain wooden scabbard, carried at his left hip and often held unsheathed in his right hand with the blade angled downward.

ref_desc: Kunjali Marakkar I has a warm medium-brown oval face with a neat black beard, wavy shoulder-length hair tied under a dark indigo turban, an off-white angarkha over deep indigo sash, dark green vest, brown trousers, and carries a curved Malabar sword with wooden scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Full-body anime-style character of Kunjali Marakkar I: a late-30s Malabar Mappila admiral with a warm medium-brown oval face, sharp cheekbones, straight nose, and neatly trimmed black beard and moustache, plus a faint scar on his left eyebrow, looking calm, alert and resolute. His thick wavy black hair is shoulder length, tied back at the nape, under a simple dark indigo turban wrapped low and close to the head with a subtle twist above the forehead and no ornament. He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style tunic that overlaps and ties on the right side, with narrow dark red borders at the sleeve cuffs, over a deep indigo cotton waist sash tightly wrapped and knotted on his left hip. Over this is a sleeveless dark green cotton outer vest, hip-length, lightly quilted and reinforced at the shoulders, with side slits suggesting practical movement for sea combat. His loose straight-falling light brown cotton trousers (churidar-style) gather modestly at the ankles, and he stands in simple dark brown leather sandals with a toe loop. A plain brown leather belt crosses the sash and supports a plain wooden scabbard at his left hip. He has a short string of small dark wooden prayer beads at his neck, a single modest silver ring on his right hand, and small plain silver studs in both ears. His signature weapon is a slightly curved Malabar sword, similar to an early talwar, with a simple iron hilt wrapped in dark brown leather and a plain wooden scabbard; show him gripping the unsheathed sword in his right hand with the blade angled downward. Use a harmonious palette of off-white, deep indigo, dark green, dark red and brown, and present him front-facing, full height, with clear, consistent detailing on face, hair, garments, accessories and sword.
